about: NIST Assembly Task Board 1 laser plate (GMC_Laser_Plate_Virtual.STL, 384 x 384 x 9 mm) placed in the board frame (mocap NIST_Board1 convention, plate top at z = 0) by the mirrored rigid transform that maps the contact-estimated hole layout onto the NIST plate features (board_contact_layout nist_fit: 17 holes, 0.76 mm RMS). Corners named by NIST plate coordinates: c00 = NIST (0,0), c10 = (384,0), c11 = (384,384), c01 = (0,384). Written by twin/camcal.py for twin/world.py renders (2026-10-24).

base.note: The plate sits on a darker frame (aluminium profiles with round end caps at the corners, seen in the hama crops); with the camera-derived plate-top height (calib board z) it fills the space down to the table. Rendered as one darker slab under the plate footprint.
